notes.title: Trine 5: A Clockwork Conspiracy Update #2 (Patch v.1.0.4)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34636198/d9046943aad977cdbdb22441e73046653cf2e0a1.png[/img]

We are happy to publish Patch 1.0.4 for Trine 5: A Clockwork Conspiracy on all platforms today! 
With this patch, players on PC, Xbox and Nintendo Switch will finally be able to play together. 


Here is the full changelog:

[h2]Trine 5: A Clockwork Conspiracy Update #2 (Patch v.1.0.4)[/h2]

[b]Major Fixes / Additions:[/b]

[list]
[*] Crossplay added between all of the following platforms in public and private games: All different PC storefronts, Nintendo Switch, Xbox One and Series.
[*] Virtual keyboard enabled for consoles for password input, allowing private games to support Crossplay.
[*] Invite feature added (does not support Crossplay!).
[*] Invites enabled for all consoles, within their own console families.
[*] In Friend Only games, Steam and Epic overlay supports inviting and joining into ongoing games, as well as inviting into lobby.
[*] Gog can invite friends into Friend Only lobbies through the invite button only.
[*] AMD: Fixed flickering shadows for older than RDNA2 cards
[/list]

[b]General fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed hosted lobbies sometimes not appearing in the "Browse Games" -list when there were many ongoing games.
[*] Plugged a memory leak.
[*] Fixed a rare case where a joining player brought in an extra local player with them.
[*] Fixed local players spawning off screen in some cases.
[/list]

[b]Save system:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a case of getting stuck joining a game when player's save slots were full.
[*] Fixed Quick Join creating new saves, if player already had a save of that game.
[/list]

[b]General Gameplay:[/b]

[list]
[*] Last used character is now remembered in Classic games if players use a character not default for their player number.
[*] Fixed being unable to descend a ledge into ledgegrab if standing slightly over the edge.
[*] Improved ledgegrabbing on sloped terrain.
[*] Disallowed client having story progress locked skills unlocked, that the host doesn't yet have, if they played the same save further on their own and then join back.
[*] Fixed "Last player remaining" -effect persisting after disconnecting.
[/list]

[b]Skills:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a rare crash when controlling another Pontius' Prismatic Talisman.
[*] Fixed object lock effect persisting on Pontius' thrown sword.
[*] Fixed some upgrades being able to use incorrect player number for their function.
[*] Exploding clone no longer deals damage to the final boss through its invulnerability.
[/list]

[b]Level 4:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a sharp camera re-focus after breaking out of the Garden Party Gazebo.
[/list]

[b]Level 7:[/b]
[list]
[*] Pontius breaks laws of physics less and can no longer get out of bounds in the level.
[*] Prevented starting a fight too early by throwing boxes ahead.
[/list]

[b]Level 8:[/b]
[list]
[*] Gate Guardian nor Tower Guardian can't get stuck anymore to their flamethrower attack if Amadeus shoves a box to their face.
[/list]

[b]Level 9:[/b]
[list]
[*] One less puzzle that can be broken with Wind Burst and cause player to get stuck.
[*] Fixed broken French localizations for opening cutscene.
[/list]

[b]Level 12:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a rope target to the bottom of the elevator near the end of level, in case player falls off.
[/list]

[b]Level 15:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixes and improvements to the Sauna secret.
[/list]

[b]Level 18 and 19:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Clockwork Mages causing softlocks by falling off or spawning so that they never teleported back up.
[/list]

[b]Localizations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed overlapping texts in Nintendo Switch's localizations of Czech, German and Japanese.
[/list]

[b]Other: [/b]

[list]
[*] Xbox: Fixed an issue that would sometimes cause joining to fail on Xbox.
[*] PS5: Fixed vibration not working on DualSense controller(s).
[*] PS5: Fixed Experienced Heroes Achievement not triggering correctly.
[*] Steamdeck: Fixed and updated on-battery frame rate limit from 30 -> 60 fps.
[*] FPS limiter is now a slider instead of a text field in Steam Big Picture mode and Steam Deck.
[/list]

notes.title: Trine & Trine 2 Editor Release and Free Weekend
notes.notes:
We are now officially releasing the [b]Trine Editors on Steam for Windows[/b]. We also patched some minor gameplay issues.

Some of you have already gotten a chance to try the editors through the Steam Beta, but now they are out for everyone to try! We have released two separate editors that each come bundled with their respective game; Trine Enchanted Edition and Trine 2. Even though the Editors look quite similar, they do have some differences - so if you have questions, please remember to specify which editor you are using. :)

[img]http://i.imgur.com/tXQ58UO.jpg[/img]

The Editors may take a while to learn how to use, so they might not be for everyone - but do give them a try and see if you are up for it! The Editors are very diverse tools that allow you to [b]edit existing maps[/b], [b]create whole new maps[/b] and [b]share your creations[/b] with others through the [b]Steam Workshop[/b]. We're really excited to see what you guys can come up with!

Check out the [b]"How to Get Started"[/b] section below for useful tips and links on how to help you get going. :) We'll also be happy to answer editor-related questions; you can email those to our [url=http://www.frozenbyte.com/contact/#Support]Support[/url], post your questions to our [url=http://www.frozenbyte.com/?p=5655]blog[/url] or in the Steam Community Discussions (links below).

One last note: since the Editors are now officially released, [b]it's recommended that those who were participating in the Beta now opt out of it[/b] to ensure they'll get all the latest updates. This is easy to do by right-clicking the games in your Steam Library, choosing Properties and navigating to the BETAS tab. The option to opt out of beta programs should be available in the drop-down menu. Remember to do this for both games.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ltzwF1f.jpg[/img]

To celebrate the official release of the editors for [b]Trine Enchanted Edition[/b] and [b]Trine 2[/b], both games are [b]free[/b] on Steam this weekend [b]16th-19th of October[/b]. The games are freely available for everyone to install and play through their Steam Library for the duration of this weekend - so remember to tell all your friends who've always wanted to try the Trine games, but have not done so yet! Since we are now officially releasing the [b]Trine Editors for Windows[/b], you'll get to try them for free as well. :)

The games are also available for purchase for a juicy sale, [b]80% off until Monday 20th[/b]! Both Trine games support both [b]local and online co-op[/b] for up to three people*, so gather your friends and have fun with Trine!
[i]*NOTE: Trine 2: Complete Story is available for Windows, Mac and Linux and has full local and online co-op support. Trine Enchanted Edition is currently only available for Windows (Mac and Linux versions are being developed), so the Mac version of Trine does not support online co-op (but does have a local co-op option!) and the Linux version of Trine is not yet available through Steam.[/i]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/4trFHUX.jpg[/img]

[h1]Frozenbyte Editors: How to Get Started[/h1]
[b]Please read before trying out the editors![/b]
[list]
[*][url=http://frozenbyte.com/wiki/index.php/Frozenbyte_Editor_hardware_and_software_requirements]Hardware and Software Requirements[/url]
[*]See [url=http://frozenbyte.com/wiki/]Editor Wiki Page[/url] for [b]installing instructions[/b], [b]FAQ[/b] and [b]general tips[/b]. This is an [b]open wiki[/b] once you've registered, so anyone can edit and post information. We hope that people will share their knowledge with everyone. :)
[*]See Steam Community discussions for changelogs, more information and questions: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/35700/discussions/0/619568793787477602/]Trine Enchanted Edition Editor Discussion[/url] & [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/35720/discussions/0/613939294246084068/]Trine 2 Editor Discussion[/url]
[/list]

That should be enough talk for a while, right? We hope you enjoy the free weekend and have fun playing and experimenting with the editors. Don't hesitate to ask any question either here, by email or in the Steam Community (links above). Have a great and Trine-filled weekend! :)

notes.title: Trine 2 Gets Six New Stages in DLC Release This Summer
notes.notes:
Frozenbyte, the makers of Trine 2, informed the site XBLA Fans at GDC that the game will be getting six new stages plus other content in downloadable content to arrive this summer.

The package will also include a new story and new character skills. Frozenbyte's Mikael Haveri said fans should expect plenty of puzzles.

Additionally, Haveri said the studio's next project would not be a sequel, and that they're looking at building another $15 game to be distributed over Xbox Live, PlayStation Network, and Steam.

Frozenbyte Talks Trine 2 DLC and a New IP [XBLA Fans]

notes.title: Trine 2 release date announced, it’s tomorrow
notes.notes:
http://youtu.be/XxPg1YeXE2E

Ridiculously pretty co-op platformer, Trine 2 will be hitting Steam tomorrow. The standard edition will cost £11.99 / $14.99 , and there's also a digital special edition. It comes with a digital art book and the soundtrack and will set you back £17.99 / $24.99 USD. If you pre-order them now, you'll get two bonus Team Fortress 2 items, a wizard hat and a spiky "War Head" helmet to "protect your thought-horde from dragons, sorcery, and other make-believe dangers."

Trine 2 can be played solo, but if it's anything like the original, it'll be much, much more fun in co-op. The three playable archetypes, wizard, warrior and thief have different specialities, and must muddle through the fights and physics puzzles with hastily improvised solutions, many of which would involve the warrior throwing the wizard around while the thief casually grapples past all danger. A new online co-op more will make it easier to play with friends as well. It looks stunning, too. Just check out these Trine 2 screenshots. You'll find a picture of the bonus TF2 items just below.

notes.title: Trine PC Patch 1.07, New Level Released to Most
notes.notes:
Those that didn't buy Trine PC via digital distributors like Steam or Impulse can now enjoy the free additional "Path to New Dawn" level added to the side-scroller last month, as a manual download of the 26.76MB v1.07 patch is now available via FileShack.

The downloadable is compatible with the Direct2Drive, GamersGate, North American retail and European retail editions of Trine. Steam and Impulse copies should have already been updated automatically via their respective digital distribution platforms, while those with Russian and Polish versions will need to wait for a separate patch.

Along with the manual download, Frozenbyte also offered up a trailer of the new level: Watch the HD video on Shackvideo.

notes.title: Trine Update Released
notes.notes:
Updates to Trine have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

Trine
  • Tweaked Steam Achievement "Still no fireball" requirement from 500 to 200 objects
  • Added new resolutions to the Launcher (uncommon resolutions can still be added by editing options.txt and setting the resolution with lines screen_height_and screen_width)
  • Added support for manually configuring which input devices to use in config\options.txt (player1_keyboard_ID, player1_mouse_ID)
  • Added Turkish language support (text)
  • Fixed "Up" control to no longer make the player jump by default
  • Fixed Windowed mode titlebar support
  • Fixed mouse cursor in widescreen (aspect ratio)
  • Fixed a rare crash when the player touches a falling rock as it breaks
  • Fixed a rare crash when a water splash effect is played while the player exits to menus
  • Fixed a rare bug that occurred when the player switched characters and died simultaneously
  • Fixed final boss animations sometimes not working properly (Tower of Sarek)
  • Fixed a co-op respawn bug with the last checkpoint (Tower of Sarek)
  • Fixed a collision issue in the Iron Forge level (caused the Thief to take damage from lava)
  • Fixed several oxygen gauge bugs
  • Fixed autoaim bugs in Tower of Sarek
  • Fixed the Boots item to work properly (reduces spike/goo damage)
  • Fixed random failure of overwriting save slots in the New Game menu
